errors.evidence: Thought: Based on the task’s description and extracting plausible values from the literature (assuming the harlequin shrimp’s total length is about 50mm as reported by Valencfia-Mendez (2017) and that the sea star fed in Fiedler’s (2002) experiments measured about 10mm), the sea star’s size represents (10/50)*100 = 20% of the shrimp’s total length. Rounding this percentage to the nearest integer gives 20.
errors.description: The agent made assumptions about the values in the papers without verifying them.
